title: Rahmas
summary: Rahmas is a former Organization mercenary and agent of Rassimov. He bears the symbol of an ankh on his right arm.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Rahmas worked as a mercenary for the Organization and was an agent of Rassimov until his disappearance. Zhalia Moon was aware of his work. [Cerberus (comic)]

Rahmas had been working for Dr. Benway who, following the defeat of the Professor, was trying to gain control of the Oganization. Rahmas had helped get Benway to a high position, however, Benway had disappeared before giving Rahmas what he was owed. Knowing Benway was after the Titan Cerberus, he went to look for it himself. He fought against Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill, Cherit and Zhalia Moon while they tried to find the location of the Amulet of Cerberus. After beating the Huntik team, Rahmas prepared to leave with the Holotome of the Sybil but Zhalia, recognising him, suggested they join forces as he wouldn't be able to get past the traps in the "Mouth of Hell". Rahmas reluctantly agreed, but was soon double-crossed by Zhalia who knocked him out.

Rahmas was then betrayed by Dr. Benway who revealed he already had the Amulet of Cerberus. Benway then attempted to execute him and Dante Vale but the pair worked together to beat Benway's forces and Dante recovered the Amulet. Dante was unable to bond with Cerberus due to being a "boy scout", leaving him with no other choice but to give the Titan to Rahmas who called Cerberus back, saving the team. Rahmas then drove off with the Titan, something Dante thought was worth losing to save his team. [Cerberus (comic)]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.wikitext: Rahmas is a ruthless mercenary who cares about himself. He doesn't hesitate to exploit a situation to his advantage, quickly pushing Dante to give him [[Cerberus]], knowing Dante would want to save his friends. However, Rahmas also had some perspective as he openly admitted that he was a bad man and noted [[Dante Vale]] had a lot of honour which was a rare sight. Nevertheless, he kept his side of the bargain and called Cerberus back. {{source|Cerberus (comic)}}

sections.text: Rahmas is a powerful Seeker and relies mainly on the Hecto-Titans of ancient Egypt. He was also able to return Cerberus to his Amulet something that even Dante couldn't do due to the darkness in him.[Cerberus]

full_text:
Rahmas is a former Organization mercenary and agent of Rassimov. He bears the symbol of an ankh on his right arm.

History

Rahmas worked as a mercenary for the Organization and was an agent of Rassimov until his disappearance. Zhalia Moon was aware of his work. [Cerberus (comic)]

Rahmas had been working for Dr. Benway who, following the defeat of the Professor, was trying to gain control of the Oganization. Rahmas had helped get Benway to a high position, however, Benway had disappeared before giving Rahmas what he was owed. Knowing Benway was after the Titan Cerberus, he went to look for it himself. He fought against Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill, Cherit and Zhalia Moon while they tried to find the location of the Amulet of Cerberus. After beating the Huntik team, Rahmas prepared to leave with the Holotome of the Sybil but Zhalia, recognising him, suggested they join forces as he wouldn't be able to get past the traps in the "Mouth of Hell". Rahmas reluctantly agreed, but was soon double-crossed by Zhalia who knocked him out.

Rahmas was then betrayed by Dr. Benway who revealed he already had the Amulet of Cerberus. Benway then attempted to execute him and Dante Vale but the pair worked together to beat Benway's forces and Dante recovered the Amulet. Dante was unable to bond with Cerberus due to being a "boy scout", leaving him with no other choice but to give the Titan to Rahmas who called Cerberus back, saving the team. Rahmas then drove off with the Titan, something Dante thought was worth losing to save his team. [Cerberus (comic)]

Personality

Rahmas is a ruthless mercenary who cares about himself. He doesn't hesitate to exploit a situation to his advantage, quickly pushing Dante to give him Cerberus, knowing Dante would want to save his friends. However, Rahmas also had some perspective as he openly admitted that he was a bad man and noted Dante Vale had a lot of honour which was a rare sight. Nevertheless, he kept his side of the bargain and called Cerberus back. [Cerberus (comic)]

Abilities

Rahmas is a powerful Seeker and relies mainly on the Hecto-Titans of ancient Egypt. He was also able to return Cerberus to his Amulet something that even Dante couldn't do due to the darkness in him.[Cerberus]

Spells Utilized

• Boltflare
• Touchram

Bonded Titans

• Ash
• Cerberus (Given by Dante)
• Thornment
